faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the AIIMS Delhi Project Coordinator position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email is 15th September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the concerned authority before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Coordinator post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MBBS/MD/MS/BDS/MDS/PHD in Health and Biomedical Science to be eligible for this position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Project Coordinator role?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for this position is 60 years. There is no minimum age limit specified.

faq.question: Q4. How much salary will be provided for the Project Coordinator position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 100,000.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process is via email. Candidates need to send their resume and required documents to the official email address provided in the notification.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for AIIMS Delhi Project Coordinator recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What are the selection criteria for the Project Coordinator post?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting of applications followed by an interview.

faq.question: Q8. How many vacancies are available for the Project Coordinator post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Project Coordinator position at AIIMS Delhi.

faq.question: Q9. What type of job is this recruitment?
faq.answer: This is a contractual job opportunity at AIIMS Delhi.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF link is available in the "Important Links" section of this article for your convenience.
